name: create_edge_config_token
description:
Create a labeled access token for an existing Global Config (Edge Config). The result may include the token value, which is a credential; handle it as a secret.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/global-config/{edgeConfigId}/token --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
